verdict.rationale: Cactus claims any HuggingFace model can be converted with `cactus convert`, but labels this experimental. The engine exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech and vision, Needle can return embeddings, and users report running Gemma 4 and loading GGUF models. Hands-on evidence is weaker: Jan Nano and SmolLM3 downloaded fine but crashed the demo app as soon as they were selected. Missing for 10: any documented list or count of supported architectures backing 'hundreds', any explicit evidence of MoE support, non-experimental broad conversion, and independent confirmation that varied architectures run reliably.
